jobs.description:
Our client is an international environmental services company dedicated to protecting the planet with sustainable mobile filtration solutions for liquids and gases.

They have approximately 450 employees, united as Generation D., all committed to driving positive ecological change across various industries.

Jobomschrijving

What does a Process Operator ?

Quality responsibility – You ensure the optimal production of high-quality reactivated carbon by precisely adjusting process parameters to maintain excellent production output.

Operational responsibility – You start up, operate, monitor, and shut down various technical installations to ensure uninterrupted production.

Problem-solving – When technical malfunctions occur, you analyze the cause and perform necessary repairs or adjustments to maintain production efficiency.

Process optimization – You actively contribute ideas for improvements to enhance efficiency and sustainability in production processes.

Forklift operation – You will use a forklift for various tasks, ensuring a smooth and safe production process.

Why You?

Are you ready to work in a dynamic and innovative environment where you can continuously contribute to improvements? Then you might be the perfect candidate!

 

Your Team as a Process Operator

You will join a fantastic team of technical operators and forklift drivers in Rumbeke, reporting directly to your team lead.

Who Are We Looking For?
	
• A strong technical background (mechanics, electricity, etc.) and a passion for technology and innovation.	
• Fluent in English and/or Dutch.	
• Forklift certification required.	
• Analytical and problem-solving skills – You can quickly detect and resolve technical issues.	
• Hands-on mentality – You are proactive and not afraid to get your hands dirty.	
• Team player – You can work well in a team but are also capable of working independently.	
• Flexibility – Willing to work in a shift system.	
• Safety-conscious – You always prioritize safety and strictly follow procedures.	
• Even if you don’t meet all the criteria but strongly identify with our core values – Teamwork, Excellence, and Devotion – we encourage you to apply!

Our client is a well-established company operating in all segments of passenger transport, including public transport, school and company transport, and coach tourism services. With multiple locations across Belgium and Luxembourg, they are looking for a skilled Bus Mechanic to strengthen their garage team in Affligem or Lede.

Jobomschrijving

 

Your Responsibilities
	
• Independently perform both simple and complex mechanical and electrical repairs and installations on buses.	
• Carry out preventive maintenance and diagnostics.	
• Report all maintenance and repair work accurately using the company's garage application.	
• Take the lead when necessary and provide support and guidance to fellow technicians.	
• Participate in technical training courses provided by various bus manufacturers.

You have a solid technical background in vehicle mechanics.

You have knowledge of vehicle electronics and can read electrical diagrams.

You are passionate about technology and work accurately, safely, and independently.

You hold a technical secondary education (TSO) diploma in Automotive Technology or have equivalent experience.

You are proactive, able to identify technical issues, and find effective solutions.

You communicate well in English, Dutch, or French.

Experience with the maintenance of suspension systems, brakes, filters, and general vehicle servicing is required.

Experience working on trucks is an advantage; experience with buses is even better.

A Category B driving licence is considered an asset, as occasional roadside assistance may be required.

Company Activities:

Our client is part of the circular economy based on wood fibers. In Belgium, the company has three units employing around 600 employees. The plant in Langerbrugge (Ghent) produces high-quality newspaper and magazine paper from 100% recycled paper. Thanks to two biomass power plants that provide the necessary process steam and three wind turbines, the company is one of the most sustainable enterprises in North Sea Port. Safety is the top priority, and thanks to intensive training programs, employees develop both professionally and personal

Jobomschrijving

Our client, a leading global producer of renewable solutions for paper, packaging, pulp, and wood constructions, is looking for an Electrical Maintenance Technician. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and maintaining the electrical network up to a voltage level of 150 kV.

Your daily tasks will include:
	
• Managing the lighting network.	
• Maintaining fire detection systems.	
• Operating frequency converters (ABB, Siemens, Danfoss).	
• Controlling various types of power switches (Siemens, ABB).

The ideal candidate should:
	
• Hold a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.	
• Have several years of experience in a similar role in an industrial production environment.	
• Be passionate about electricity and keep up-to-date with the latest trends in the field.	
• Think pragmatically and solve problems.	
• Plan and organize work effectively, with a focus on achieving results.	
• Communicate in English or Dutch at a good level.

Our client specializes in bodywork and mechanical repairs for all car brands.

Jobomschrijving

Our client is looking for a skilled tinsmith to join their team. You will be responsible for the repair, maintenance, and installation of metal components. As a tinsmith you will play a key role in restoring and repairing vehicles or metal structures.

 

Your Responsibilities:
	
• Performing sheet metal work, including repairing damaged parts.	
• Installing and removing body panels, metal coverings, or structural components.	
• Metal processing (bending, straightening, cutting, welding).	
• Preparing surfaces for painting or further treatment.	
• Following safety regulations and maintaining a clean workspace.

Candidate Profile:
	
• Minimum 2 years of experience as a tinsmith.	
• Proficiency in using sheet metal tools (hammers, welding machines, grinders, etc.).	
• Knowledge of materials and techniques used in sheet metal work.	
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.	
• Attention to detail and precision in executing tasks.	
• Communicative knowledge of English or Dutch.

Our client is building one of the most advanced glass factories in the world in Lommel. This ultramodern site excels in sustainability, automation, and technological innovation. As a TECHNICIAN, you play a key role in the maintenance and operation of this state-of-the-art production environment, where safety, efficiency, and environmental awareness are at the forefront.

Jobomschrijving

Well before the startup, you will begin thorough training in day shifts to fully understand our installations, systems, and standards, enabling you to help set the standard in this unique factory from day one.

Depending on your background (electrical or mechanical), you will be deployed as a technician within one of the maintenance teams. Your tasks will include:
	
• Analyzing and resolving technical faults in machines and installations	
• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance	
• Calibrating, adjusting, and checking parts and systems	
• Contributing ideas for technical improvements within your department	
• Working closely with fellow technicians and operators for safe and stable operation	
• Accurately recording interventions in the maintenance system

Profile:
	
• You have completed technical training or have relevant experience in maintenance	
• You are strong in mechanical and/or electrical areas	
• You are solution-oriented and enjoy working in a team	
• You are skilled in reading technical plans or schematics	
• You can work in a day-shift and are looking for a stable, long-term challenge	
• You speak good English.

Our client is building one of the most advanced glass factories in the world in Lommel. This ultramodern site excels in sustainability, automation, and technological innovation. As a TECHNICIAN, you play a key role in the maintenance and operation of this state-of-the-art production environment, where safety, efficiency, and environmental awareness are at the forefront.

Jobomschrijving

Profile:

• You are solution-oriented and enjoy working in a team

jobs.occupation: Store Assistant / Sales Associate – Christmas Shop | Bruges | Full-Time
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working in a welcoming retail environment and love the magic of Christmas? Do you enjoy helping customers find the perfect decorations for the holiday season?

For a unique Christmas store in the heart of Bruges, we are looking for an enthusiastic Store Assistant / Sales Associate who will help customers bring the Christmas spirit into their homes.

What will you do?
As a Sales Associate, you will be the face of the store and ensure that every customer enjoys a warm and pleasant shopping experience.

Your responsibilities include:

• Welcoming and assisting customers in a friendly manner
• Advising customers on Christmas decorations, ornaments, gifts and seasonal products
• Maintaining an attractive and organized store presentation
• Restocking shelves and keeping the store clean and tidy
• Processing payments and handling cash register duties
• Assisting with deliveries and unpacking new merchandise

• You enjoy working with customers and providing excellent service
• You are willing to work weekends on a rotating schedule
• Previous retail or sales experience is an advantage
• You speak Spanish, Dutch or English fluently
• In addition to your strongest language, you can communicate at a basic level in at least one of the other languages
• You enjoy working in an international environment with tourists and visitors from different countries
• You are enthusiastic, reliable and enjoy working as part of a team

As a Legal Secretary, you will provide high-quality administrative and organisational support to a team of lawyers, ensuring the smooth management of schedules, client communications, travel arrangements and legal documentation. You will also collaborate with internal teams across the Brussels and international offices.

 

Client Details

Our client is a leading international law firm with a strong reputation for excellence and a collaborative working environment. To support its Brussels office, the firm is looking for a highly organised and proactive Legal Secretary.

 

Description

As a Legal Secretary, you will provide comprehensive administrative support to a team of lawyers and contribute to the smooth running of the office. Your responsibilities will include:

• Agenda management, organisation of meetings en events.
• Coordinating travel arrangements.
• Handling calls, emails and correspondence.
• Preparing, formatting and proofreading legal documents, presentations, reports and correspondence.
• Supporting billing processes and expense reporting.
• Working closely with colleagues across the Brussels and international offices to ensure seamless support.

 

• You have at least 2 years of experience in an administrative, Legal Assistant, Management Assistant or Executive Assistant role.
• Experience within a legal or professional services environment is an asset.
• You are fluent in English, French is a plus
• You have excellent organisational skills and strong attention to detail.
• You can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy and professionalism.
• You are proactive, adaptable and able to work both independently and as part of a team.

As a Credit Controller, you will manage a portfolio of B2B debt collection files, ensuring timely payments while maintaining professional client relationships. You will coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, monitor legal procedures, and contribute to achieving collection targets in a structured and dynamic environment.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established and respected organization active in the automotive sector. They offer a collaborative environment, professional training opportunities, modern working practices, and a strong focus on employee development and work-life balance. 

Description

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and follow up on B2B collection files.
• Analyze outstanding debt cases and monitor recovery procedures.
• Contact customers via phone, email, and written correspondence regarding overdue payments.
• Send payment reminders and formal notices.
• Maintain and update administrative records and internal systems.
• Coordinate with external partners, legal representatives, bailiffs, and internal departments.
• Monitor accounting statuses and liaise with the finance team.
• Prepare tailored repayment proposals.
• Ensure proper follow-up of ongoing legal and collection procedures.
• Identify risks and suggest process improvements to management.
 

Profile We're Looking For

• 3+ years experience in credit collection and credit control
• Medior level professional with a structured way of working.
• Comfortable working in a B2B environment.
• Interest in legal procedures and debt recovery processes.
• Strong administrative and organizational skills.
• Good communication skills and confidence when dealing with customers.
• Proactive attitude and willingness to learn.
• Good command of French; Dutch or English is a strong advantage.
• Comfortable using different IT systems and tools.

As a Finance Administrator, you support the daily operations and ensure smooth financial processes. You take ownership of administrative, payment and reporting tasks in an international setting.

Client Details

This opportunity is with a reputable organization in the financial services sector, operating across multiple markets, known for its high standards and entrepreneurial mindset.

Description

As a Finance Administrator your responsibilities are:

• Provide administrative support as needed
• Manage accounts payable and ensure accurate invoice processing
• Execute payments and liaise with banking partners
• Follow up on approvals and maintain financial workflows
• Support fund operations including capital movements and reporting
 

A successful Finance Administrator should have:

• Minimum 2-3 years of experience in finance, accounting or administration
• Fluent in English and Dutch or French
• Strong attention to detail and structured way of working
• Proactive mindset with ownership and accountability
• Motivated to grow in a demanding, high-performance environment

Client Details

You will be joining the newest division of a global player in the field of recruitment, which has also won the Top Employer award several times in a row.

Description

• Attend presentations and meetings
• Approach a network of customers and candidates
• Persuade them to work with you on their recruitment needs
• Negotiate terms, brief them and advise them on their recruitment needs
• Manage the entire recruitment cycle, from candidate selection to offer management
• Participate in job fairs and universities

• You are a driven, social and entrepreneurial person
• You can work autonomously while remaining a real team-player
• You are a persuasive and compelling person able to sell yourself and the company
• You are adaptable and can change your style of delivery depending on your audience

As Executive Assistant to the Executive Committee, you will support senior executives with agenda management, travel coordination, meeting organisation and administrative follow-up. Our client is a leading international industrial group headquartered in Belgium. To support several members of the Executive Committee, the company is looking for a dynamic and proactive Executive Assistant in Brussels.

As Executive Assistant, you will provide high-level administrative and organisational support to three C-levels, allowing them to focus on strategic priorities.

Your responsibilities will include:

Join an international medical non-profit organisation dedicated to promoting equitable access to resilient healthcare systems worldwide, including in Belgium, with the mission of ensuring that no one suffers or dies from preventable and treatable diseases.

The organisation operates across multiple countries, advancing public health through sustainable healthcare initiatives. It provides expert, compassionate care to people affected by tuberculosis and neglected tropical skin diseases, such as leprosy and leishmaniasis, which are closely associated with poverty, while working in close collaboration with local health systems and communities.

Jobomschrijving

You lead individual donor retention strategy to maximise donor lifetime value and drive sustainable fundraising growth through data-driven donor journeys, strong donor loyalty, and an outstanding donor experience.

Your role ?

1. Individual Donor Retention Strategy

• Define and lead the long-term individual donor retention strategy,
• Own and continuously optimize the donor lifecycle (welcome, engagement, upgrade,loyalty, reactivation).
• Drive donor retention, lifetime value and sustainable individual giving revenue.
• Align retention priorities fundraising objectives

2. Donor Experience & Engagement

• Ensure a consistent, seamless and donor-centric experience across all touchpoints.
• Lead multi-channel donor stewardship and engagement initiatives.
•  Strengthen donor loyalty, advocacy and long-term commitment through personalized engagement.
•  Coordinate stakeholders involved in the donor journey to ensure consistency and impact.

3. Performance & Continuous Improvement

• Define, monitor and report on retention, engagement and lifetime value KPIs.
• Translate donor insights into strategic recommendations and improvement actions.
• Evaluate initiatives and optimize resource allocation based on impact.
• Foster a data-driven culture of continuous improvement.

4. Data-Driven Donor Journeys

• Advance the use of donor data to personalize journeys and improve decision-making
• Partner with ICT and CRM teams to ensure reliable data, segmentation and automation.
• Optimize donor journey processes through data, testing, and technology.
• Ensure donor engagement is supported by accurate, actionable and shared data.

5. Mission-led Donor Communications

• Strengthen the emotional connection between donors and Damien Foundation.
• Shape donor communications together with Brand & Acquisition to maximize engagement and loyalty.
• Ensure storytelling and engagement support long-term donor commitment and sustainable revenue growth.
• Contribute to a coherent donor experience aligned with the organization's positioning.

6. Data Governance & GDPR Compliance

• Ensure all donor engagement, retention, communication, and data management activities comply with GDPR requirements and internal data protection policies. 
• Safeguard donor privacy, consent management, data accuracy, and the secure use of personal data across all channels and systems

• You have a master's degree in marketing, Sales, Economics, Communications, or equivalent experience.
•  You have a minimum of 5 years' experience in donor engagement, individual giving, donor retention, CRM-driven marketing, or customer/donor lifecycle management, with a proven ability to design and optimize data-driven journeys that strengthen loyalty, lifetime value, and long-term support.
•  Experience in the non-profit or social impact sector is an asset.
•  You are fluent in French and Dutch, with professional proficiency in the other national language and excellent written and spoken English.
•  Strong organizational skills, with a focus on efficient processes, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
•  Strong digital mindset, with the ability to support digital transformation and leverage digital tools to achieve strategic objectives.
•  Opportunity-driven, action-oriented, and results-focused, with strong attention to detail and a proven ability to deliver long-term results.
•  Strong leadership, project management and change management skills.
•  Proven people management experience, with the ability to lead and develop teams through organizational transformation while fostering a culture of open communication and collaboration.
•  Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate donor data into actionable insights.
•  Experience with CRM systems, donor segmentation, and marketing automation.
•  Experience with ERP software is an asset .
•  Excellent writing skills and communication skills

Our client is an international company combining a corporate, international culture with a strong focus on efficiency, quality, and innovation. They support business operations through technology-driven solutions and continuous improvement of internal processes.

The environment is collaborative and evolving, offering employees the opportunity to grow and develop within the company. The company is located in Brussels and is easily accessible with public transport.

Jobomschrijving

As L&D HR Officer, you'll be responsible for:

• Coordinate, organize, and deliver training sessions
• Maintain & update the training catalogue
• Identify development needs and manage relationships with external training providers
• Ensure accurate HR data management and documentation (training records, performance data, job files)
• Coordinate and manage the performance management cycle (ensuring timely completion of objectives setting and reviews)
• Act as key user of HR tools providing user support and driving adoption across the organization
• Maintain and update job descriptions, job grading, and organizational charts
• Support career development initiatives
• Contribute and support HR activities when needed

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in HR, training, education, or a related field
• Fluent in English, with a good command of French or Dutch
• First experience in HR, HR Development, Learning & Development, or a similar role (junior profiles welcome)
• Dynamic, proactive, and able to convince stakeholders to adopt new tools and processes
• Strong organizational skills with a structured and detail-oriented mindset
• Curious and hands-on, with a willingness to learn and take ownership of HR systems and tools
• Strong communication skills with the ability to interact at all levels of the organization
